Around 70% of hydrogen production cost is directly related to (renew - able) electricity, so the price of electricity determines, to a large extent, the price of green hydrogen. Thus, the German government has initiated bilateral talks with several countries (such as Angola, Morocco, Namibia and Turkey) to explore hydrogen imports through international gas pipelines or in the form of hydrogen -derived products.
